comparison.objective: Push two reject cartons off a moving line while leaving good cartons undisturbed; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires timed lateral pushing of moving objects and selective disturbance avoidance, rather than seated-tool torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Scores each correctly routed reject and penalizes disturbed good cartons or invalid routes; candidate scores angle, nut retention, functional cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Dynamic sorting on a conveyor tests interception and selective pushing, not threaded adjustment retention.
